description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 large storage room. Corner-aspect apartment, windows on four facades, exceptional natural light throughout. Kitchen island present, hob on island facing dining table and living area. Cook at island faces the room, suited to cooking while entertaining or supervising children. Wall counter on left side provides additional workspace and storage. Very large open plan space (70.6sqm) with generous dining, seating and kitchen zones. Living arrangement: wall counter and kitchen island on left, dining to the right of island, large seating area on far right. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom (9.3sqm); 1 WC-only room (2sqm). Parallel morning routines possible. Both bedrooms in lower private zone (21.6sqm and 19.1sqm), no en-suite. Very large storage room (25.6sqm), suitable as walk-in wardrobe, home gym, laundry or hobby space. Entry from bottom near right side. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples who entertain frequently, households prioritising large living space and abundant storage.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children needing multiple bedrooms
rooms_summary: 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom, 1 living (open plan), 1 large storage
